footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Transcontinental Realty Investors: after $629K attributable to noncontrolling interests. The data provider reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow. Operating income follows StockAnalysis, which places unusual items below the operating line: $17.7M gains/losses on asset sales, −$284K other unusual items in 2025; −$589K gains/losses on asset sales in 2024 (signs as reported: negative = charge).

Figures are from StockAnalysis (S&P Global Market Intelligence data) for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier; free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items not reported there are left out.
Diluted EPS by quarter as reported in the 10-Qs; fourth quarters are calculated (net income ÷ estimated diluted shares) because EPS does not add across quarters.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Transcontinental Realty Investors is a Dallas-based company that owns apartment communities and commercial real estate. Revenue rose 2.7% to $49.1M in 2025. The operating loss widened to $6.3M from $5.1M.
Net income rose 2.4× to $13.8M, or $1.60 per share. Operating cash flow was −$2.9M and free cash flow −$2.9M, versus $1.3M.
